name: GDPR — Data Protection Impact Assessment
methodology: Article 35 + ICO 7-step DPIA template. WP248 9 high-risk criteria gate whether a DPIA is required.

domains.name: Identify the need for a DPIA

controls.title: Does the processing involve any of the 9 WP248 high-risk criteria? (evaluation/scoring; automated decision with legal effect; systematic monitoring; sensitive/special category data; data processed on a large scale; matched/combined datasets; data of vulnerable subjects; innovative use of new technology; processing that prevents data subjects from exercising a right or using a service)
